Definition: to press; (by implication) to be close, hurry, withdraw
BiblicalUsage: When the morning arose, the angels hastened Lot, saying, arise, take thy wife and thy two daughters, and the taskmasters hasted the people, saying, fulfil your works, your daily tasks.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe haste tells you who is pressing: the angels hastened Lot to save him and the taskmasters hasted Israel to break them, and the same word carries a rescue in one hand and a whip in the other.
